Perks › Common

Five Alive

Common perk · Scoring bonus

A scoring play with an open-end total of exactly 5 adds another 5 points.

In-game card text

How it works

A scoring play whose open ends add up to exactly 5 gains +5 points for each copy, so a single copy turns a 5-point play into 10.

  • Five Jinx wipes out a play that totals exactly 5, bonus included.
  • The Long Charge also pays out on a total of exactly 5, so the two work together.

At a glance

RarityCommon
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 120 Bone Bucks.
